lead: A right-click menu: it opens on right click (long press on touch) over the trigger area. Items, groups and separators reuse the parts and theme styles of [Menu](/menu).

api.title: API Reference
api.items: `Item` / `CheckboxItem` / `Group` / `GroupLabel` / `Separator` are the [Menu](/menu) parts of the same name, used exactly as in Menu.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: ContextMenu has no CSS file of its own: its whole look comes from `menu.css`. As with every overlay, `data-skein-theme` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.trigger: The trigger area (theme styles usually leave it unstyled)
styling.menu: The popup and its items, reusing Menu's slots
